mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days. The relationship is negative: lower FEDFUNDS implies higher returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below historical median, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 206 signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 206, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high FEDFUNDS (above 5.0) and high CPIAUCSL (above 205) signal a restrictive monetary policy environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when both FEDFUNDS>5.0 and CPIAUCSL>205, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 205), a higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 5.0) compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL>205 and FEDFUNDS>5.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A HOUST (housing starts) reading below 1500 signals weak consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days as the Fed may ease policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 1500, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An INDPRO (industrial production) reading above 112.5 signals strong supply growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days as markets anticipate rate cuts.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO > 112.5, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high PAYEMS (employment) and low UNRATE (unemployment rate) signal a tight labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days as inflation fears subside.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS>137000 and UNRATE<4.6, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (GDPC1 > 11500 and HOUST > 1500), a high RSAFS (retail sales) reading above 370000 signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when GDPC1>11500 and HOUST>1500 and RSAFS>370000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
